profile_text.body:
Apple is a public company founded in 1976 and headquartered in Cupertino, California, trading on public markets under the ticker AAPL. Its most recently reported annual revenue was $416,161,000,000, as filed in a 10-K covering the period ending September 27, 2025. The company's AI-focused web presence centers on Apple Intelligence and Siri, which it describes as integrated, privacy-first AI built into iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS Golden Gate, watchOS 27, and visionOS 27. The site characterizes the next generation of Siri AI as a conversational assistant capable of open-ended questions, in-app actions across Messages, Music, and Reminders, writing assistance, on-screen and real-world object recognition, and HomeKit Secure Video summarization, with an initial rollout in English and an explicit note that it will not initially be available in the EU on iOS, iPadOS, and watchOS.

The site tracks three AI products for Apple: Apple Intelligence, described as an on-device large language model using Private Cloud Compute and Apple silicon with a privacy-first orientation; Final Cut Pro AI, a Mac video editing product using on-device processing optimized for Apple silicon; and iMovie AI, a consumer video editing tool with trailer templates also running on-device. Two MCP servers are registered in connection with Apple, one for managing Apple Ads campaigns and reporting and one providing Apple Developer Documentation with semantic search, retrieval-augmented generation, and AI reranking for MCP clients.

The held facts record 161 legal cases associated with California as Apple's primary law exposure jurisdiction, though no specific case details are included in the available data. Apple holds a verified SEC filing profile under CIK 0000320193.
